purpose: Collect independent terminal recovery/exhaustion instances after the separately retained e036 calibration verified persistent-hold scheduling and activation.
inclusion_rule: Include only if simulator/capture gates pass, one accepted goal and matching aborted result/status are captured, recovery-count history is complete with exactly two unique Wait entries matching final feedback, evaluator truth records a scheduled and actual persistent hold with mobilityHeld=true and mobilityReleased=false, and the former paired-boundary exception is absent.
mismatch_rule: Retain every attempted instance. Do not rerun, replace, tune, or relabel an instance after observing its outcome.
independence_basis: Each instance has a distinct seed, corridor width, goal distance, and hold boundary. They are within-family replications of one synthetic mechanism; questions remain clustered by episode.
evidence_boundary: Hold identity and timing remain evaluator-only. Robot-visible explanations may describe FollowPath/recovery/terminal mechanisms but must withhold the physical cause.
